name: Shimmer Spinefish
tooltip:
Shimmer Spinefish
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
A stalwart silver spinefish whose body encourages Anglers and fish alike to explore before jutting its coarse spines in their direction. A beautifully grumpy friend to no-one, but a welcome treasure for any aspiring Angler.

Special:

Fresh Fillet

Salvaging this fish with the Cooking skill will produce Fresh Fillet.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Eversong Woods
- Harandar

Fishing Pools:
- Bubbling Bloom
- Sunwell Swarm
- Bloom Swarm
- Blossoming Torrent

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
